# Cattle: Species Guidance

Cattle breeding simulations should preserve pedigree, sex, cohort, herd,
contemporary group, dam, sire, and repeated-record metadata. Dairy and beef
populations can differ substantially in selection intensity, generation
interval, family structure, and trait definitions. Genomic selection should be
evaluated using time-aware and family-aware splits, not only random folds.
